title: Kaaƴe-Ceerooɓe Falnde Hiiɗnde
intro: Miijo-ɗee siwil ummoriiɗo e falndeeji kaaƴe Aarabeeɓe, baawɗo ƴettude cuuɗi mawɗi gila e dow koye. Ɓe ƴellitii e doole e naalankaagal, kono daartol maɓɓe ina maantini e ƴattooje jeertinaango Alla. No njiyru-ɗaa daartol maɓɓe nii, aɗa yiytoo leñol ngol mawnikinaare mum addani ɗum en halkude ɗum en haa laaɓi. Hol ɓe ngonnoo?
clues: En ndokkii leydi kaaƴe e kaaƴe toowɗe, ɗo min mahi hoɗorɗe amen e karallaagal ngal alaa ko nanndi e mum.
Min nganndiranoo ko ƴettude cuuɗi kisal e nder koye amen, min njiɗi ko kisal e kala bonannde.
Nelaaɗo waratii en e nder men, ina siftina en moƴƴere Alla, ina jeertina en jukkungo.
Min ɗaɓɓi maande, gelooɗi debbo kaawis yalti e haayre ndee, jarribo laaɓngo ummoraade e Alla.
En njaɓaani jeertinaango ngoo, en njuppii gelooɗi ɗii, en njuumtii nulaaɗo oo, en luulndiima jukkungo ngoo.
Puccu gooto yani e amen e nder galleeji amen, haa subaka min njuuli, min meeɗaa hoɗde toon.
verse: So as for Thamūd, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast]. (69:5)
